blockers.finding: SO_PEERCRED authenticates the peer process, but the claimed preflight-source identity is inferred from that process's Python executable inode and /proc cmdline. A same-identity process can rewrite its own argv storage (the data exposed by /proc/<pid>/cmdline), so these predicates do not prove that preflight_launch.py issued the capability.
blockers.required_repair: Bind the child to an unforgeable, already-authenticated preflight-held object or descriptor whose identity/contents the child verifies; do not use self-controlled cmdline text as the source-code trust root.

blockers.finding: The authorization chooses required_status and validation only requires receipt.status to equal that chosen string. Neither source-audit nor runtime-audit status is frozen to an independently defined PASS value, so a correctly sealed BLOCK receipt can be rebound as acceptable evidence.
blockers.required_repair: Freeze exact PASS schemas/status strings for both independent audits in the stage contract and enforce them in preflight and core independently of authorization-supplied values.

blockers.finding: Authorization-time absence and parent inode checks are separated from result creation by the runtime replay and full experiment. At write time os.mkdir(path.parent) and os.open(path) are separate pathname resolutions; no held parent/run-root dirfd or inode recheck closes rename/replacement between them.
blockers.required_repair: Hold an authenticated output-parent dirfd, create the run root relative to it, open and verify the new directory by descriptor, and create/fsync result relative to that held directory before any pathname publication.

blockers.finding: The contract requires total_bytes_before_free and all_per_cell_gpu_arrays_deleted_before_free for all 48 cells and all five stable-order adversaries. Stable-order memory_release rows record neither field.
blockers.required_repair: Record and validate the complete six-field memory evidence object for every stable-order adversary, then refreeze all dependent hashes.

blockers.finding: After del pair_x/pair_words/pair_masks, Python's last loop bindings still retain masks and, for controls, x/words when free_all_blocks is called. The call therefore cannot close all panel allocations and no used_bytes/synchronization assertion detects it.
blockers.required_repair: Delete every live GPU-bearing loop local, synchronize, assert used_bytes()==0, free, and assert used/total closure before continuing.
